question: Multiplex population collapse: Clone-mode iterate copies the selected shard's slots (dead ones included) and never refills to CAP. What should iterate do?
decision: Add a 'Refill to cap' toggle (BREEDING tab, with help), ON by default, persisted with the other multiplex settings. When on, Clone-mode iterate tops each new shard back up to full population: copies of random survivors (bonds/partner/entanglement/age reset, nudged apart) before the normal per-sim variation; if no survivors, respawn from the source shard's DNA. Dead slots are reused in place (no compaction, which would break index-based bond/partner/entanglement refs). Spawn mode and generation 0 unchanged. Full population = the explicit PARTICLES/SIM or POP%/SIM cap; with the automatic cap (MAX_PARTICLES/sqrt(shards), e.g. 50,000) it is the generation-0 per-shard population, to avoid ~50x preview sims. This deliberately changes default iterate behaviour; approved by Gem.
